description.en: Rhine Lab-style boot animation for DeepSeek Harness: six acts from a black title plate through irradiated white-out to a warm dossier panel, five access-authorization steps (the first two can wait for a click or Enter, and Esc skips), real-voice recordings for the first five lines, and a settings page that switches between warm-light and dark themes and live-edits 33 playback, identity, voice and visual options.
description.zh: 莱茵生命风格的 DeepSeek Harness 启动动画：黑幕标识 → 过曝洗白 → 暖白档案底板 → 五步访问授权（前两步可设为等点击/回车，Esc 可跳过）→ 色散揭幕，前五句为真声台词；设置页提供暖白/暗色两套主题，并可实时调整播放、身份、语音与视觉等 33 项参数。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sidebar plugin: stack-safe fork tree, two-track indentation, marquee title, leading/hover slots, and cascade purge.
把一个目录里的每个 .md 变成能对话的 agent 人设
An automatically mounted, presentation-only progressive tool disclosure layer for every DeepSeek Harness Agent preset in Native, Code, and Both modes.
Tobs (formerly DeepSeekBot): Team of bots, with persistent identity and memory on DeepSeek Harness. Legacy package and commands remain supported.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: an MCP status button in the chat header showing which MCP servers answer right now
DSH 会话接力插件 · 长会话到点先问你一句，把需求/进度/下一步写成交接文档，开个干净新会话接着干（手动 /handoff 或自动触发）。 Session handoff for DeepSeek Harness.
让大肥鱼活在抖音上：新私信叫醒 agent，能回私信、发评论、回楼中楼、读通知、分析视频；带频率上限、去重和发完核对。
BotHarness-qualified IM Provider, maintained from dsh-im

Left sidebar panel list for DeepSeek Harness: long-press drag to reorder panel icons, one arrow to fold them all, whole-row height caps, a pinned-session section that keeps its live running / waiting status, draggable conversation view tabs, archived Sess
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加拖拽排序、置顶会话和状态显示，让会话管理更顺手。

description.en: The shared UI foundation for DSH plugins, with a live component preview: design tokens, common controls, workspace browsing and notifications maintained in one place — install it to preview every component in a real host.
DSH 插件：右侧栏常驻「余额明细」——DeepSeek 余额、赠送钱包，以及今日 token 消耗（本机 DSH 会话 + 平台全部 API Key，重叠时按平台口径只算一次）/ 命中 / 未命中 / 输出 / 消费金额 / API 请求次数。
Gemini 紫夜主题与角色装饰 for DeepSeek Harness Desktop (Windows and macOS)
Message box for DeepSeek Harness: finished-conversation and pending-approval notifications with jump-to-conversation and inline approval.
Upsello: a Shopify store-operations agent for DeepSeek Harness - a DSH bundle plugin with store tools, an operator persona, and a sidebar entry
Deterministic auto-dispatch for native DeepSeek Harness Agent Teams: wakes idle members when a task becomes ready, and turns advisory write scopes into an effective soft lock.
Weixin iLink channel for DeepSeek Harness — text, media, persona modes, companion pacing and proactive messages.
Native Deepwork roles, routing, profiles, and permission controls for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让多个 Agent 分工干活，各角色可配不同模型和备用模型，还能保存常用方案、防护 Git 写操作。

description.en: Drag or paste files into the Web composer with one image-and-file preview rail; native PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF keep the image attachment path, while other files reuse a matching local path or stream to Host staging and become @ references only at send time. Includes browser media/PDF and bounded text previews; Office and archives show identity cards, and unsent file entries are page-local.
description.zh: 把文件拖入或粘贴进 Web 输入框，图片与文件共用预览栏；PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 保留出厂图片通道，其他文件优先引用匹配的本地路径，否则流式暂存到 Host，发送时才追加 @ 引用。提供浏览器媒体/PDF 和限长文本预览；Office 与压缩包显示身份卡，未发送文件清单仅保存在页面内。

description.en: DeepSeek balance and token usage panel for DSH, with official platform billing, a daily usage calendar, and local session-log estimates for all providers using editable per-model pricing.
description.zh: DSH 里的 DeepSeek 用量面板：官方账户余额与账单、每日用量日历，以及按可编辑的逐模型费率估算全部 Provider 的本地会话日志用量。

description.en: VS Code style 44px icon rails for the side panels DSH collapses: the left rail keeps the sidebar navigation and the bottom action rows, the right rail lists the sidebarRightTabs ledger so third-party tabs appear on their own, and the right panel is drag-resizable between 300px and 60% of the window. Two switches under Settings → Activity Bar, saved in this browser.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 收起后的两侧栏变成 VS Code 那样的 44px 图标条：左条接管侧边栏导航与底部动作行，右条按 sidebarRightTabs 清单自动列出第三方面板，右侧面板可拖动改宽（300px 至窗口 60%）。设置里的「活动栏」两个开关，按浏览器保存。

description.en: Browse archived DSH sessions grouped by workspace in Settings, filter and search them, restore one in a click, or delete a session log from disk for good.
description.zh: 在设置里按工作区分组浏览已归档会话，可筛选、搜索、一键恢复，或把会话日志从磁盘彻底删除。

description.en: Fork of z-col/dsh-workspace-groups (MIT): a grouped workspace sidebar for the DSH web client, with a science icon set and a docked default workspace; cannot be installed alongside the upstream plugin (same bundle row).
description.zh: z-col/dsh-workspace-groups（MIT）的分支：DSH Web 客户端的分组工作区侧栏，带材料与实验图标集，默认工作区停靠底栏；不能与上游插件同装（同一个 bundle row）。

description.en: A draggable floating window with three tabs — meals, water, standing. It picks breakfast, lunch and dinner at random (three tries a day, no repeats, editable food lists), counts water cups and standing breaks, and reminds you with a distinct 3-second chime per tab. Collapses to a 32px ball.
description.zh: 可拖动的悬浮小窗，分吃饭、喝水、站立三个 tab：随机决定三餐（每天各 3 次机会、不重复、可增删菜品），记录喝水与站立，每类提醒各用一种音色响约 3 秒；可收成 32px 悬浮球。

description.en: A fork of dsh-boot-animation that plays an intro clip when DSH opens, ships four embedded clips with an in-app library, and adds batch deletion for clips you added yourself. It reuses the same plugin id as upstream, so the two cannot be installed together.
description.zh: dsh-boot-animation 的社区分支：打开 DSH 时播放片头动画，内置四段片头并可管理片库，新增片库批量删除（同步删除自己加入的视频文件）。沿用上游同一插件 id，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Desktop pet for DSH with voice chat, personas, memory, Bilibili, QQ context, and command-gated computer control.
description.zh: DSH 桌面宠物：语音聊天、多人设、聊天记忆、B 站视频与 QQ 群记忆（只读本地文件）；「电脑操作」需在面板里显式打开总开关后才响应语音指令。

description.en: Snapshot and switch the Codex login used by the Codex subagent from the DSH Plugins page, with a Codex usage quota card.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页管理 Codex 子智能体使用的登录账号：保存/切换 auth.json 快照，并显示该账号的 Codex 额度。

description.en: Ships the Codex UI 1.1.49 sidebar inside the plugin itself, so no upstream release can change the interface, and adds a real delete to the session menu: it provides the remote.workspaceRegistry.deleteSession service, unhides the per-session ... button, and permanently removes the session log, workspace records and projection cache, with subagent and forked conversations selectable in a family-tree dialog. Bundles the Codex UI 1.1.49 sidebar from MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui (Apache-2.0) — do not install both; the delete engine is adapted from Lzcdebear/better-dsh-session-deletetool (MIT).
description.zh: 把 Codex UI 1.1.49 的侧边栏内置进插件，上游更新换不掉界面；提供 remote.workspaceRegistry.deleteSession 让会话菜单出现「删除会话」，放出被样式隐藏的「...」按钮，永久删除会话日志、工程记录与投影缓存，子智能体与派生对话可在家族树里逐项勾选。内置 MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui（Apache-2.0）1.1.49 侧边栏，请勿与上游同装；删除引擎改编自 Lzcdebear/better-dsh-session-deletetool（MIT）。

description.en: Composer control for the automatic context-compaction threshold. A 20%-80% slider rewrites the running BasicCompactionEngine config per step, shows current usage, context window and the effective trigger line, and compacts immediately when the threshold drops below current usage and the agent is idle.
description.zh: 输入框旁的上下文自动压缩阈值控制器：20%-80% 滑条按 step 重写运行中 BasicCompactionEngine 的配置，显示当前用量、上下文窗口与实际触发线；阈值降到当前用量以下且 Agent 空闲时立即压缩。

description.en: Registers a QwenWork (千问办公) model provider that reuses the desktop client's local sign-in, runs a loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge on 127.0.0.1, and translates DSH model requests into the ACP-style control-envelope conversation protocol the upstream actually speaks.
description.zh: 注册千问办公（QwenWork）模型提供器，复用桌面客户端的本机登录态，在 127.0.0.1 起一个 OpenAI 兼容回环桥，把 DSH 的模型请求翻译成上游真正使用的 ACP 控制信封对话协议。

description.en: Remove the finished turns of selected calendar dates from the model-visible context of a live DeepSeek Harness session, while the chat transcript and the append-only session log stay untouched.
description.zh: 按日期把已经结束的对话轮次从 DeepSeek Harness 会话的模型上下文里移走，聊天记录与只追加的会话日志保持原样。

description.en: Shows per-answer and conversation cost estimates from recorded token usage, with automatic model pricing updates and detailed price-source breakdowns.
description.zh: 根据已记录的 Token 用量估算每轮回答和会话费用，支持自动更新模型价格及查看价格来源明细。

description.en: Assign per-session duotone SVG icons and colors from the sidebar menu or a model tool, with browser-local persistence and cross-tab updates.
description.zh: 为每个会话设置双色 SVG 图标和颜色，可通过侧边栏菜单或模型工具操作，并支持浏览器本地持久化与跨标签页更新。

description.en: A workbench for tasks, pending replies, AI news, knowledge, multi-provider web chats, and developer tools. Message capture and pending replies need a 云之家 (Yunzhijia) account with its yzj-cli, and web chats only run in the desktop app.
description.zh: 智能工作台，集成待办、待回复、AI资讯、知识空间、多AI对话与开发工具；消息采集与待回复需云之家账号及 yzj-cli，多 AI 对话仅桌面端可用。

description.en: Choose API hostnames from configured providers or add them manually to route matching DSH backend Fetch/Undici requests through an existing local HTTP(S) proxy, leaving other routes unchanged; optional in-memory records show actual dispatch paths, first-content wait, token throughput and usage without storing prompts, responses or API keys.
description.zh: 从已配置的 Provider 选择 API 域名或手动添加，让命中的 DSH 后端 Fetch/Undici 请求通过已有本机 HTTP(S) 代理，其他请求沿用原有路线；可选开启内存调用记录，查看实际分发路线、首内容等待、token 速度与用量，不保存提示词、回答或 API Key。

description.en: Dual-host coordination for DeepSeek Harness (大肥鱼 bot): hand a task off in local chat, run bounded jobs in a cloud worker, then review results and approve follow-up steps in one workbench. Includes protected six-page onboarding, per-task model selection, a task approval ledger and stepwise controlled delivery.
description.zh: DSH 双端协作（大肥鱼 bot）：在本地对话中自然语言交办，云端独立 worker 执行有界任务，在工作台查看成果并逐步审批后续动作。含六页保护性配置导览、按任务选模型、审批账本与受控交付。

description.en: A reflection layer for DSH sessions that slowly rewrites a 3-7 entry worldview across value, preference and habit layers, tracks spirit, health and account balance, ingests Bilibili/Douyin videos, and keeps an auditable growth archive. Video intake is optional and needs site cookies; Douyin parsing also needs Edge/Chrome and yt-dlp.
description.zh: 给 DSH 主会话的人格反思层：每日把对话与视频素材沉淀成 3–7 条分层原则，跟踪精神、健康与账户余额，并保留可审计的成长档案；视频摄入为可选项，需站点 Cookie，抖音解析另需 Edge/Chrome 与 yt-dlp。

description.en: IDEA-style Git tool window for DSH: branch tree with ahead/behind badges, commit graph with text/branch/author/date/path filters, staged and unstaged changes with a commit box, commit details with per-file line diff, stash and worktree management, a git console log, and AI commit-message drafting. Fork of KannaKuron/dsh-ide-git (MIT), reworked to register native DSH entries instead of depending on dsh-better-sidebar and extended with worktree management, undo for branch, stash and discard actions, a git console log and AI commit-message drafting. Its plugin, route and sidebar-tab ids differ from the upstream, so both can be installed, but you get two Git tool windows.
description.zh: DSH 里的 IDEA 风格 Git 工具窗口：带 ahead/behind 角标的分支树、可按文本/分支/作者/日期/路径筛选的提交图谱、已暂存与未暂存变更和提交框、提交详情与逐文件行级 diff、贮藏与工作树管理、git 控制台日志，以及 AI 撰写提交信息。KannaKuron/dsh-ide-git（MIT）的 fork：改用 DSH 原生入口注册（不再依赖 dsh-better-sidebar），并新增工作树管理、分支/贮藏/丢弃的撤销、git 控制台日志与 AI 撰写提交信息。插件、路由与侧栏 tab 的 id 均与上游不同，两者可同装，但会出现两个 Git 工具窗口。

description.en: Harness² recursive self-improvement for DSH agents: Propose–Probe–Compose, isolated probes, anonymous selection, and a per-domain experience library.
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 通过 Harness² 的 Propose–Probe–Compose 循环，从真实执行证据中持续改进提示词、技能、脚本与领域经验库。

description.en: Replaces the composer model button with one panel holding a provider-grouped model list with search, pinned favorite models, and a reasoning-effort slider with one stop per level the model advertises, whose aurora gradient and glow grow with the level; the last effort used with each model is restored when switching back, and the built-in selector stays registered underneath as a fallback.
description.zh: 用一个面板替换输入框的模型按钮：按服务商分组的模型列表与搜索、置顶的收藏模型，以及按模型声明档位分级的思考程度滑杆，其极光渐变与光晕随档位增强；切回某个模型时恢复上次用过的档位，内置选择器仍作为备用保持注册。

description.en: Rewrites outgoing /chat/completions requests with an evolved chain-of-thought scaffold (nine-dimension genome, elitist selection with fragment crossover, one deterministic re-evaluation pass), scores answers against a fixed 20-objective baseline, and appends one line per rewrite to live-requests.jsonl in the plugin data root (default <cwd>/.aecot, overridable with AECOT_ROOT).
description.zh: 在请求边界重写出站的 /chat/completions 请求体，注入进化出的九维思维链支架（精英保留、片段交叉、一次确定性复评），用固定 20 目标基线打分，每次改写追加一行到插件数据根目录下的 live-requests.jsonl（默认 <cwd>/.aecot，可用 AECOT_ROOT 覆盖）。

description.en: Kimetsu no Yaiba (Demon Slayer) skin for the DSH Web UI: a night-forest palette applied through the stable token layer, nine rotating wallpapers served by the plugin host, a flame band, and a two-button dock to toggle the skin and change the picture.
description.zh: 《鬼灭之刃》DSH Web 皮肤：通过稳定令牌层应用鬼杀队配色，插件宿主提供的 9 张轮换壁纸、顶部火焰带，右下角两颗按钮分别负责开关皮肤与换壁纸。

description.en: An unofficial Windows desktop pet that responds to DSH Agent activity; the plugin alone does not show the pet — download the official Neutralino 6.9.0 x64 runtime separately and set rendererEnabled, assetDirectory and runtimePath in %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\kurowhale-pet\local.json.
description.zh: 响应 DSH Agent 状态的非官方 Windows 桌宠；只装插件还看不到它——需另行下载官方 Neutralino 6.9.0 x64 运行时，并在 %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\kurowhale-pet\local.json 里配置 rendererEnabled、assetDirectory 与 runtimePath。

description.en: Turns real DSH crash logs into a short hard-constraint list: static preflight before a plugin installs, conflict check afterwards, controlled self-heal when the harness will not start — plus handing a huge session over to a fresh one, the brief written by a model that reads the original transcript.
description.zh: 把 DSH 真实崩溃日志沉淀成精简硬约束：装插件前静态预检拦崩，装完体检冲突，起不来时受控自愈；大会话还能转世成新会话，交接单由模型读懂原会话后写。

description.en: On-demand tool loadout for DSH: MCP tools are grouped by server and host plugin tools by prefix; grouped tools hide by default and activate with one call, while tools claimed by no rule stay visible. Ships preset modes (coding / writing / ops / review), a trial zone that promotes new tools after repeated use, gated groups that need user confirmation to activate, an outbound cut while reading the web as prompt-injection defense, and built-in search plus proxy call for long-tail tools.
description.zh: DSH 的按需工具装配：MCP 工具按 server 自动分组、宿主插件工具按手工前缀分组，进组的默认隐藏、一句话激活，没被规则认领的始终可见。另带写代码/写材料/运维/只读审阅内置模式、新工具观察区用多了自动转正、敏感组激活要用户点头、读网页当轮切断外发组防提示注入，以及长尾工具的内置搜索和代理调用。

description.en: Markdown display enhancements for the DSH Web chat, applied on top of the host renderer rather than replacing it: code blocks become cards with a language label and icon-only wrap and copy buttons, long code blocks, tables and Mermaid diagrams fold behind an expand control, Mermaid fences render as SVG with a diagram and code toggle, a fullscreen viewer with wheel zoom, drag and double-click to fit, and SVG or PNG export, tables get a sticky header and CSV or Markdown copy buttons, and a settings panel adjusts the diagram palette, code font size, the default diagram view and the three fold thresholds.
description.zh: DSH Web 会话的 Markdown 显示增强，在宿主渲染之上加样式与按钮而不替换渲染器：代码块变成带语言名和图标按钮（换行、复制）的卡片；超长的代码块、表格与 Mermaid 图会折叠，底部可展开收起；Mermaid 围栏渲染成 SVG，可在图形与代码间切换，支持全屏查看（滚轮缩放、拖拽、双击适应）以及导出 SVG 或 PNG；表格表头吸顶，并提供 CSV 或 Markdown 复制；设置面板可调图表配色、代码字号、图表默认视图和三类折叠阈值。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: pinned rules injected every turn, the rest recalled by IDF-weighted keyword evidence, fact-key dedup, plain JSON storage, and a settings page to edit or delete entries.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话长期记忆：规则和坑每轮注入，其余按 IDF 加权关键词召回；事实键去重、明文 JSON、设置页可增删改。

description.en: Evolving memory infrastructure for DSH — evidence, time, context, and correction for long-term continuity — backed by a local Python 3.11+ memory service (fastapi/uvicorn/pydantic, started automatically as a python3 subprocess).
description.zh: DSH 演化记忆基础设施：用证据、时间、情境与纠错支撑长期连续性；后台是本地 Python 3.11+ 记忆服务（fastapi/uvicorn/pydantic，插件以 python3 子进程自动启动）。

description.en: Native generation-time Mixture-of-Agents: every turn, reference models run the same session context in parallel as pre-run drafts and one aggregator executes with full tooling; config-as-model recipes, F mirror / R trimmed views, subagent gating.
description.zh: 原生生成时 MoA：每轮参考模型并行预演同一会话上下文产出草稿，单一聚合模型带完整工具循环执行；配置即模型配方、F 镜像 / R 裁剪双视野、子会话门控。

description.en: Two-level model picker for the DeepSeek Harness composer: browse providers, then models, search across all providers or within one provider, select supported reasoning-effort levels, and navigate with arrow keys, Enter and Esc.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框的两级模型选择器：先选供应商再选模型，支持全局与供应商内搜索、可用思考强度设置，以及方向键、Enter 和 Esc 操作。

description.en: Configurable personas, separate reply generation, and evidence-backed memory with review and correction for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置人格、独立回复生成，以及支持审核和修正的可追溯记忆。

description.en: Connects OpenCode Go subscriptions to DSH Desktop, with API-key management, usage snapshots, automatic model synchronization, and model selection.
description.zh: 将 OpenCode Go 订阅接入 DSH 桌面版，提供 API key 管理、用量快照、模型自动同步和模型勾选。

description.en: Device-pairing gateway for DeepSeek Harness: by default it listens on 127.0.0.1:3443 over plain HTTP and reverse-proxies the local dsh at http://127.0.0.1:3080, so a loopback-only install works without any certificate. Production, cross-machine and app pairing require TLS: configure tlsCert/tlsKey plus an https publicUrl (self-signed is fine). A fronting Caddy/Nginx may terminate the public TLS, but the gate itself still needs tlsCert/tlsKey and the proxy must connect back over HTTPS. Features TOTP-authorised QR device pairing, username/password login, sliding sessions with absolute caps, device revocation, a WebUI admin panel and audit log, and a reverse proxy with WebSocket tunnelling. First-run setup is completed in the WebUI wizard. Tests: 171/171 unit tests, 29-step e2e.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的设备配对网关：默认只监听 127.0.0.1:3443（明文 HTTP）并把请求反代到本机 http://127.0.0.1:3080，本机安装无需证书即可使用。生产/跨机/App 配对必须配置 TLS 证书（自签即可）与 https 的 publicUrl；若在前置 Caddy/Nginx 终止对外 TLS，网关自身仍须配置 tlsCert/tlsKey，并由代理以 HTTPS 回源。功能：TOTP 授权的扫码设备配对、用户名密码登录、带绝对上限的滑动会话、设备吊销、WebUI 管理面板与审计日志、含 WebSocket 隧道的反向代理。首次初始化在 WebUI 向导中完成。测试：单测 171/171、e2e 29 步。

description.en: Refuses agent-generated SQL that reads tables or columns outside a configured blacklist or whitelist, returning a structured permission reason instead of rewriting the query.
description.zh: 拒绝智能体生成的越权 SQL：读取的表或字段不在黑白名单策略内时直接拒绝，返回结构化权限原因，不改写查询。

description.en: An isolated translation pipeline where each module is its own model call carrying only its own prompt and its own input — no session history, no tool schemas, no other module's content. Build chains from draggable cards, edit any module's prompt in place, override the model per module, or start from one of two precision presets. The same chain is exposed to the agent as a translate_flow tool.
description.zh: 隔离式翻译链路：每个模块都是一次独立的模型调用，只携带自己的提示词和自己的输入——不带会话历史、不带工具定义、不带其他模块的内容。用可拖拽卡片编排链路，就地编辑任意模块的提示词，按模块覆盖模型，也可直接套用两套精译预设。同一条链路还以 translate_flow 工具的形式提供给智能体。

description.en: Back up, restore and two-way sync DSH plugins and configuration through your own Git repository, with conflict handling, snapshots and six agent tools.
description.zh: 用你自己的 Git 仓库备份、恢复并双向同步 DSH 插件与配置，支持冲突处理、快照与 6 个 Agent 工具。

description.en: Power Mode typing effects for the DSH web composer: caret particles and glowing character echoes, a heat ramp from amber to red with rising embers as the combo grows, a combo counter over visible glyphs, and a synthesized key tick with a heavier Enter impact.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的 Power Mode 打字特效：光标粒子与发光残影，连击越高当前输入行越热（暖黄到红）并升起余烬，按可视字符累计的连击计数，以及合成的按键音与更重的回车冲击音。

description.en: Turn your recurring one-liners into capsules above the composer. They reorder themselves by how often you use them, and ask you to fill in {{placeholder}} values before the snippet lands in the draft. Clicking appends rather than replaces, so a half-written draft survives. A drawer adds search, grouping and editing, and everything lives in a Host-side JSON file you can edit by hand.
description.zh: 把每次都得重打的那几句话做成输入框上方的胶囊。它们按使用次数自动重排，带 {{占位符}} 的会先弹框让你填，填完才插入草稿。点击是追加而不是替换，写到一半的草稿不会被冲掉。抽屉里可以搜索、分组、编辑，数据存在 Host 侧 JSON 文件里，可以直接手改。

description.en: Two composer actions for the DSH Web UI: /new in the slash-command menu starts a new conversation without sending anything to the model, and Shift+Tab toggles plan mode while the conversation has focus.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的两个操作：斜杠菜单里的 /new 新建对话且不向模型发送任何内容，对话区按 Shift+Tab 切换计划模式。

description.en: Adds a collapsible Recent list to the bottom of the DSH Web sidebar: sessions from every workspace sorted by last activity, filtering empty, archived and subagent sessions, with the host status dots and ten more rows per click.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧栏底部加一块可折叠的「最近」列表：跨工作区按最后活动时间排序，过滤空白、已归档与 subagent 会话，复用宿主状态点，首屏 10 条、每次点击再多 10 条。

description.en: Edit a sent message in place and resend it as a forked chat, keeping the original: change the text, remove, reorder or add images and files, with session image limits checked before sending (the first message opens a new chat in the same workspace). Also @-references pending images by file name, drag-reorders composer attachments, copies messages together with their images, and adds copy, download and drag-to-composer for images in the conversation.
description.zh: 在消息位置编辑已发消息并以 fork 出的新聊天重发，原聊天保留：改文字、删图、调整图片顺序、补图片或文件，发送前按会话图片限制校验（第一条消息在同一工作区新开聊天）。另外支持输入 @ 按文件名引用待发送图片、拖动调整输入框附件顺序、复制消息时连图片一起复制，以及对话图片的复制、下载和拖进输入框。

description.en: Adds a restart button to the Windows title bar, left of the minimize control, that stops and relaunches the desktop shell together with its Harness Host so a newly installed plugin takes effect.
description.zh: 在 Windows 标题栏最小化按钮左侧加一个重启按钮，结束并重新拉起桌面外壳与 Host，让刚装好的插件立即生效。

description.en: Chat turn accordion: every interaction folds into one row with a time pill and question summary, only the newest turn stays open, and switching sessions or starting a new turn resets the open state; the execution process opens only on its own click.
description.zh: 会话交互折叠：每次交互压成一行（时间胶囊 + 提问摘要），只保留最近一次展开；切换工作区/会话或产生新交互都会重置到最新一条；执行过程仅在单独点击时展开。

description.en: Names every new DSH session DATE | CATEGORY | NAME from the session model, with a deterministic local fallback.
description.zh: 用「日期 | 分类 | 名称」自动命名 DSH 新会话，模型不可用时本地降级。

description.en: Windows x64 bundle with the official Antigravity ACP runtime included. Delegates one-shot text tasks with selectable native authentication, model and thinking level for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3.
description.zh: 内置 Google 官方 Antigravity ACP 运行时的 Windows x64 完整包，委派一次性文本任务，支持选择原生认证方式、模型和思考强度，兼容 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3。

description.en: Cuts what a long session pays for context: reads only the requested lines, keeps a prose head plus a heading digest for oversized pages, and keeps both ends of large shell output. Measured 91-99% fewer tokens on files, pages and command output.
description.zh: 降低长会话的上下文开销：只读取指定行，对过大的网页保留正文头部与章节摘要，对过长的 shell 输出保留首尾两端。在文件、网页和命令输出上实测节省 91–99% 的 token。

description.en: A read-only overview tab beside the conversation: what this round asked, what was observed, what still needs checking, and a bounded history you can step through round by round.
description.zh: 对话旁的只读概览页：本轮问了什么、观察到什么、还在验证什么；已结束的轮次可以一条条往回看。

description.en: Agent tools that download a Bilibili video, transcribe it with a local whisper.cpp build, then write a structured Markdown note with DSH's own LLM (optionally printing it to PDF). Windows only: missing dependencies are auto-downloaded into the data directory — yt-dlp.exe and the ffmpeg.exe build from GitHub and gyan.dev, the whisper.cpp x64 binary from GitHub, and a ~547 MB model from the hf-mirror mirror; PDF export shells out to a locally installed Edge/Chrome. Two tools: video_to_notes and note_to_pdf. Pure JS, no extra API key.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频下载、本地 whisper.cpp 转写、再用 DSH 自身 LLM 生成结构化 Markdown 笔记（可打印为 PDF）的 agent 工具。仅支持 Windows：缺依赖时自动下载到数据目录——yt-dlp.exe 与 ffmpeg.exe（GitHub、gyan.dev）、whisper.cpp x64 二进制（GitHub）、约 547 MB 模型（hf-mirror 镜像）；PDF 由本机安装的 Edge/Chrome 无头打印。提供 video_to_notes 与 note_to_pdf 两个工具，纯 JS，无需额外 API key。

description.en: High-performance fork of SAOS-3624/dsh-video-storyboard — install this or the upstream plugin, not both. Turns a video into addressable storyboard grids (numbered cells, a timestamp and transcript line per cell, audio envelope); needs Node 20+, ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH, and a configured ASR endpoint when the file has no subtitle track.
description.zh: SAOS-3624/dsh-video-storyboard 的高性能分支，与上游二选一、不能同装。把视频压成可寻址的宫格分镜（编号、每格时间戳与台词、音频包络）；需要 Node 20+、PATH 上的 ffmpeg/ffprobe，文件无字幕轨时还需配置 ASR 端点。

description.en: Local video color editing with camera-matched DJI Log LUTs, independent highlights and shadows, optional skin and selective color controls, frame previews, and 10-bit HEVC export. The universal tarball listed here ships no runtime: its first-launch "configure environment" button downloads a pinned platform runtime (Python 3.12 + FFmpeg 9, ~100 MB) over HTTPS, or point it at your own Python 3.10+ and FFmpeg/ffprobe 8+; the platform-suffixed release packages bundle that runtime.
description.zh: 本地视频调色工作台，支持 DJI Log LUT 匹配还原、高光与暗部独立调节、可选肤色与局部颜色控制、逐帧预览和 10-bit HEVC 导出。此处列出的通用包不带运行时：首次启动点「配置独立环境」会经 HTTPS 下载固定版本的平台运行时（Python 3.12 + FFmpeg 9，约 100 MB），也可改用自备的 Python 3.10+ 与 FFmpeg/ffprobe 8+；带平台后缀的发行包才内置运行时。

description.en: Rebuilds the sidebar into a workspace / group / session tree with drag-to-group, per-row status and context rings, and resizable sidebars; the per-session cost column needs the dsh-claude-style plugin and shows — without it.
description.zh: 把左侧栏重做成「工作区 → 分组 → 会话」树，支持拖拽归组、行内状态环与上下文环，以及可拖拽调宽的侧栏把手；会话花费列依赖 dsh-claude-style 插件，未安装时显示 —。

description.en: Whole-interface zoom from 75% to 200% in 5% steps via a Settings row, a session-header stepper or Ctrl/⌘+wheel, with a shim that converts rects, viewport units, media queries and pointer coordinates so fixed overlays stay anchored to their triggers.
description.zh: DSH 整体界面缩放（75%–200%，5% 一档）：设置行、会话头部步进器、Ctrl/⌘+滚轮三种入口；内置 shim 换算 rect、视口单位、媒体查询与指针坐标，使 position: fixed 浮层始终贴住触发元素。

description.en: Zotero skill for DeepSeek Harness: searches the local library, exports BibTeX, inserts citations into LaTeX and Markdown drafts, reads attachment full text on demand, and imports a ranked daily digest of new papers from OpenAlex. The Python entry point uses only the standard library and talks to the local Zotero API and the Zotero Connector. Adapted from OpenAI's MIT-licensed Zotero plugin (openai/plugins); daily auto-import scheduling is Windows-only.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Zotero 文献库技能：检索本机文献库、导出 BibTeX、为 LaTeX 与 Markdown 草稿插入引用、按需读取附件全文，并按 OpenAlex 指标每日导入新论文。Python 入口只依赖标准库，仅通过 Zotero 本地 API 与 Connector 通信。改编自 OpenAI 的 MIT Zotero 插件（openai/plugins）；每日自动导入的定时任务仅支持 Windows。

description.en: FanFrame refines DeepSeek Harness with sharp corners, readable chat, restrained motion, sidebar layout and plugin-list tools.
description.zh: 繁界为 DeepSeek Harness 整理直角界面、聊天富文本、折叠与浮层动效、侧栏布局及插件列表工具。

description.en: Windows PowerShell 5.1 skill for downloading large GitHub release assets: it first read-only probes the host (listening local proxy ports, system proxy and env vars, an installed Clash Verge core and its config, curl version), measures KB/s of four routes in parallel (existing proxy, headless-spawned core, public mirrors, direct), runs a short time-boxed concurrency ladder on the winner, then downloads the asset in parallel curl byte ranges and verifies the byte count plus SHA256 against the release digest. Skips the ladder when the asset is under 100 MB or a single connection already reaches 3 MB/s, because concurrency only pays off when a single connection is throttled: measured 6.3x on a throttled node (1,234 to 7,759 KB/s) but 0.72x on a fast one (5,829 vs 4,175 KB/s). Needs no aria2 or 7z, never changes the system proxy, never asks the user for ports or concurrency, reports ASSET_NOT_FOUND with the real candidate names instead of silently picking a different file, and degrades to a size-only check with DOWNLOAD_SIZE_OK_NO_DIGEST when a release predates digests.
description.zh: 在 Windows PowerShell 5.1 上下载 GitHub Release 大资产的技能：先只读自检宿主环境（在监听的本地代理端口、系统代理与环境变量、已安装的 Clash Verge 内核及其配置、curl 版本），四条路线（现有代理 / 无头拉起内核 / 公共镜像 / 直连）并行实测 KB/s，在胜出路线上做限时并发阶梯，再用 curl 多段 range 并发下载，并按 release 的 digest 校验字节数与 SHA256。资产小于 100 MB 或单连接已到 3 MB/s 时直接跳过阶梯——并发只在「单连接被限速」时才有收益：实测限速节点 6.3×（1,234 → 7,759 KB/s），节点不限速时反而是 0.72×（单流 5,829 vs 16 段 4,175 KB/s）。不要求预装 aria2/7z，不改系统代理，不向用户索要端口或并发数；资产名对不上会报 ASSET_NOT_FOUND 并列出真实候选，绝不静默换文件；老 release 没有 digest 时降级为 DOWNLOAD_SIZE_OK_NO_DIGEST。

description.en: An orange-tabby desktop pet for dsh-pet — 32 transparent VP9-alpha actions, 512×512 at 8–12fps, with the matte and QA toolchain that produced them.
description.zh: 橘猫桌宠「耄耋」——32 个透明动作（512×512 / 8–12fps / VP9-alpha），附抠像与体检工具链。

description.en: Bundled Pixiv skill backed by a Python CLI: search illustrations, manga and novels, browse daily/weekly/monthly/rookie/original/AI/R-18 rankings, look up works, novel series and artists, and download originals, with multi-page works merged into PDF, ugoira converted to GIF and novel series merged into TXT; requires Python 3.9+ with requests, img2pdf and Pillow installed (pip install -r requirements.txt), and R-18 content needs your own Pixiv cookie.
description.zh: 内置 Pixiv 技能，由 Python 命令行脚本实现：搜索插画、漫画、小说，查看日榜/周榜/月榜/新人榜/原创榜/AI 榜/R-18 榜，查询作品、小说系列和画师详情，下载原图，多页作品合成 PDF、动图转 GIF、小说系列合并成 TXT；需要 Python 3.9 以上并装好 requests / img2pdf / Pillow（pip install -r requirements.txt），R-18 内容需要自己的 Pixiv Cookie。

description.en: End-to-end PowerPoint assistant preset for DeepSeek Harness with editable deck generation, template-preserving edits, rendering and structural quality checks. Needs Python 3.10+ with requirements.txt installed; rendering also needs LibreOffice and pdftoppm, and OCR of scanned documents needs Tesseract.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的一条龙 PowerPoint 助手预设，支持可编辑演示文稿生成、保留模板的修改、渲染和结构质量检查。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装 requirements.txt；渲染另需 LibreOffice 与 pdftoppm，扫描件 OCR 需 Tesseract。

description.en: Local long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with SQLite storage, automatic extraction, semantic recall, corrections, reliable forgetting, and an in-app summary dialog.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地长期记忆：SQLite 存储、自动提炼、语义召回、纠错、可靠遗忘，以及内置记忆摘要弹窗。

description.en: Per-workspace session defaults for DeepSeek Harness: save the Agent preset, permission preset, model, reasoning effort, Chat work-details level and collapse timing per workspace; new or reused blank sessions in that workspace start from them.
description.zh: 按工作区保存 DeepSeek Harness 的会话默认值：模式、权限预设、模型、推理强度、Chat 工作步骤展示与收起时机；在该工作区新建或复用的空白会话自动应用这些值。

description.en: Sidebar todo list for DeepSeek Harness — grouped buckets, recurring tasks with weekday or month-day rules, a month-view calendar, and an agent tool that reads and writes the same JSON file.
description.zh: 侧栏待办清单——逾期/今天/本周分组、循环任务（每周多选周几、每月指定几号）、月视图日历，agent 通过工具读写同一份 JSON。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 安全交底记录核对：依据《建筑施工安全技术统一规范》《建设工程安全生产管理条例》（GB 50870-2013、JGJ 59-2011）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 核对安全技术交底记录的填写完整性和签字闭环，只提示差异，不下结论。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 论文投稿材料核对：依据《试题元数据规范》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查试卷解析结果的结构是否自洽，确保每道题的题号、题干、答案和分值都齐全。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 铁路运单与时效核对：依据《铁路营业线施工安全管理办法》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查铁路施工天窗台账的时间和算术是否自洽，帮施工和调度人员快速发现记录漏洞。

description.en: Registers the workbuddy model provider by mounting dsh-llm-workbuddy and supervises the local wb2api gateway, then bundles two protocol bridges onto that same gateway: Responses for OpenAI Codex CLI, and Anthropic Messages for Claude Code and Claude Desktop, which see the gateway models under generated claude-wb-… ids. Skips work that is already running or already registered, and reports each part through a status tool. Requires a local wb2api gateway and a WorkBuddy account.
description.zh: 通过挂载 dsh-llm-workbuddy 注册 workbuddy 模型 provider，托管本地 wb2api 网关，并在同一网关前内置两条协议桥：给 OpenAI Codex CLI 的 Responses，以及给 Claude Code 与 Claude 桌面端的 Anthropic Messages——后两者以生成的 claude-wb-… id 看到网关模型。已在运行或已注册的部分会跳过，并通过状态工具汇报各环节状况。需本机有 wb2api 网关并有 WorkBuddy 账号。
